extracted.intended_audience: students and researchers of classical mechanics; readers of Newton's Principia (Latin)
extracted.subtask_description: Latin excerpt from Newton's Principia containing propositions and problems about motion under centripetal forces: relations among velocities, areas proportional to time, trajectories (circles, ellipses, hyperbolas, parabolas), and methods to determine times and positions. Useful for studying orbital motion and geometric methods in classical mechanics.
